hero.title: YEFFA Learning Platform
hero.subtitle: A next-generation e-learning solution designed to empower over 30 million young farmers across North Africa.

overview.title: Project Overview
overview.subtitle: A complete and scalable platform for modern agricultural education.
overview.objectiveText: Deliver modern, high-quality agricultural education accessible to millions of young farmers across North Africa.
overview.reachText: Serving 5+ countries with multi-language support and content adapted to local needs and farming realities.
overview.innovationText: AI-powered personalization, AR-based training modules, modern analytics, and high-engagement pedagogical tools.

features.title: Key Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need for high-impact agricultural learning

about.title: Growing the future of farming
about.lead: YEFFA connects farmers with modern training, trusted experts, and community-driven knowledge to scale sustainable growth across North Africa.
about.missionP1: Every farm deserves access to modern tools and locally relevant know-how. We blend agronomic science, AI-assisted personalization, and human mentorship to keep training grounded in real field conditions.
about.missionP2: From Morocco to Egypt, we are building a connected network of farmers, agronomists, and cooperatives—so knowledge flows freely and resilience scales with every harvest.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.text: Eco-friendly, climate-smart practices that protect land and livelihoods for future generations.

unity.title: Regional unity
unity.text: Connecting cooperatives and unions to share resources, research, and best practices across borders.

community.title: Community first
community.text: Keeping farmers at the center with mentorship, forums, and collaborative learning cohorts.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.text: Bringing AI insights, AR field simulations, and data-driven coaching to everyday farming.
